name: coleo
description: AI agent orchestrator using the Octopus Model

scripts.build: bun run versions:check && bun run setup && bun run --cwd server/web-app build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r server/web-app/dist/ dist/web/ && mkdir -p dist/brain && cp -r server/src/brain/templates dist/brain/templates && bun build server/src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.pack:check: bun run build && bun pm pack --dry-run
scripts.check: bun run shellcheck && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration:spec
scripts.test:unit: bun test server/src/db/__tests__/ server/src/agent/__tests__/ server/src/api/__tests__/ server/src/api/routes/__tests__/ server/src/arm/__tests__/ server/src/brain/__tests__/ server/src/cli/__tests__/ server/src/config/__tests__/ server/src/embedding/__tests__/ server/src/harness/__tests__/ server/src/lib/__tests__/ server/src/mail/__tests__/ server/src/mcp/__tests__/ server/src/mcp/config/__tests__/ server/src/nats/__tests__/ server/src/qdrant/__tests__/ server/src/scripts/__tests__/ server/src/vector/__tests__/ server/web-app/__tests__/ server/src/workbench/__tests__/
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch server/src/db/__tests__/ server/src/agent/__tests__/ server/src/api/__tests__/ server/src/api/routes/__tests__/ server/src/arm/__tests__/ server/src/brain/__tests__/ server/src/cli/__tests__/ server/src/config/__tests__/ server/src/embedding/__tests__/ server/src/harness/__tests__/ server/src/lib/__tests__/ server/src/mail/__tests__/ server/src/mcp/__tests__/ server/src/mcp/config/__tests__/ server/src/nats/__tests__/ server/src/scripts/__tests__/ server/src/vector/__tests__/ server/web-app/__tests__/ server/src/workbench/__tests__/
scripts.dev:core: concurrently --prefix-colors 'cyan,blue' --names 'api,brain' 'bun run server/src/cli/index.ts serve start' 'bun run brain'
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --prefix-colors 'cyan,blue,green' --names 'api,brain,web' 'bun run server/src/cli/index.ts serve start' 'bun run brain' 'bun run web:dev'
scripts.dev:core:restart: bun run server/src/cli/index.ts serve restart && bun run server/src/cli/index.ts brain restart
scripts.dev:core:stop: bun run server/src/cli/index.ts serve stop; bun run server/src/cli/index.ts brain stop
